topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Oh, you wouldn't believe what happened! My neighbor, Tom, just came by. He's a super nice guy, but he asked me something that's got me thinking a mile a minute. He wants to use a part of my yard for a garden. I mean, I’ve got plenty of space, and it’s not like I’m using that corner for much. He promises to take care of everything and even said I could have some of the veggies. It’s a big step to let someone into your personal space like that, you know? I’m weighing my options, trying to be open but also mindful of what feels right. What do you think I should do?
